label: RecordedInstrument
description: A legal instrument as a county recorder or clerk of court entered it into the public record against a property — a deed, mortgage, lien, lis pendens, judgment, or satisfaction — identified by its recording (instrument) number. Epistery-published vocabulary: schema.org has no type for a recorded land-records instrument. The instrument number is the identity; the parties, the affected parcel, the document type, and the recording date are what it carries. A link from an instrument to a specific parcel is reported with its confidence (confirmed vs. name-only), never asserted.

identity.note: The @id is the recording office plus the instrument number. The instrument number alone is unique only within one office.

fields.name: instrumentNumber
fields.description: The recording office's own recording number — the instrument's identity.

fields.name: docType
fields.description: The instrument kind as the recording office labels it, verbatim.

fields.name: instrumentType
fields.description: Normalized category, one of: lis_pendens, lien, final_judgment, mortgage, satisfaction.

fields.name: recordDate
fields.description: When the instrument was entered into the public record.

fields.name: caseNumber
fields.description: Associated court case number, when the instrument is a court filing.

fields.name: consideration
fields.description: Stated monetary consideration, when the instrument carries one.

fields.name: parcelId
fields.description: The parcel the instrument affects, when matched to one. The match confidence is reported, never asserted.

fields.name: legalDescription
fields.description: The legal description of the affected property as recorded.

fields.name: parties
fields.description: The named parties. role is grantor (the party the instrument runs from) or grantee (the party it runs to).

fields.name: source
fields.description: The recording office this record came from.
fields.example: Broward County Clerk of Courts (SFTP bulk)

fields.name: url
fields.description: Link to the origin's own record for this instrument, when available.

trust.note: Reserved — recording proof points (recorder/clerk of record, instrument number, recording date, and the confidence of any parcel match) as the market defines them. An instrument is authoritative as the public record entered it; a parcel match is only as strong as its match type.
